title: Composer 2 - Frontier-Level Coding Model
description: Cursor released Composer 2, a state-of-the-art AI coding model achieving frontier-level performance on CursorBench with competitive pricing at $0.50 per million input tokens and $2.50 per million output tokens.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor Composer 2 is just Kimi K2.5 with RL. The entire company is built on packaging open source and reselling it.
Composer 2 is usable. Working well with medium level styling issues and complex handling of some APIs.
I still have trust issues but so far it's working well

title: Version 2.6 - MCP Apps and Team Marketplaces
description: Cursor 2.6 introduces MCP Apps with interactive UIs in agent chats, team marketplaces for sharing private plugins, JetBrains IDE integration via ACP, enhanced debug mode, and improved subagent capabilities.

title: Persistent Agent Threads for Pro and Max Plans
description: Claude Code released persistent agent threads for Pro and Max plan users, enabling task management in Cowork from both mobile and desktop platforms with enhanced cross-device control.

title: Version 0.111.0 - Windows App and GPT-5.4 Support
description: OpenAI released Codex CLI 0.111.0 featuring the official Windows app available via Microsoft Store, ChatGPT device-code sign-in, GPT-5.4 model support, full-resolution image inspection, expanded js_repl capabilities, and real-time transcription.

title: Version 0.32.0 - Generalist Agent and Model Steering
description: Gemini CLI v0.32.0 introduces a generalist agent enabled by default for improved task delegation and routing, model steering in workspace, plan mode improvements, PTY shell support, and agent skills expansion.

community_feedback.quote: The NEW Gemini CLI Update is INSANE!
Has anyone created subagents in gemini cli to work well with skills? I have tried to build subagents that are instructed to use a skill.

title: Version 0.34.0 - Chat Resume and UI Polish
description: Gemini CLI v0.34.0 adds UI polish, core fixes, new tools, and a chat resume footer for session management.

title: Progressive Web App (PWA) Support
description: Devin can now be installed as a Progressive Web App on both desktop and mobile devices. Users can install Devin by opening app.devin.ai in Chrome or Edge and using the install option from the address bar.

title: JetBrains Plugin Version 2.12.14
description: Codeium released JetBrains plugin version 2.12.14 for Windsurf, continuing improvements to the AI-powered code editor featuring Cascade agent capabilities.
